title: Generative endpoint map entry (Experimental)
description: PT-GEN-002 Experimental L-Exec entry under provider endpoints.<op>. Keys should align with ME-001 generative capability names (image_generation / speech_to_text / text_to_speech). OpenAI paths are adapter samples, not SoT uniqueness. Omit = unknown for optional encoding fields.

path.description: Path relative to endpoint.base_url (or absolute URL if vendor requires).

adapter.description: Wire adapter id (e.g. openai). Informational for runtimes; not a product brand.

request_encoding.description: How the request body is encoded. Omit if unknown.

response_encoding.description: Primary response body shape. Omit if unknown.
